replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
I'm sorry, But the judges for the map building contest have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

- The thin bridges on Brimstone Island are a huge choke point of the map, there is so much traffic that accumulates on the bridges, it just really doesn't have the best gameplay. Please add in more says to cross, or improve the bridges by expanding.
- There are barely any buildings or obstacles. The actual terraforming of the map is completely fine, but the lack of buildings or other structures related is very small. Maybe a few shacks or possibly some towers?
- I really do love this map, but I feel that so much more could be added to it. We have tested it multiple times, and it hasn't had very good gameplay.   

Aesthetics -  3/5
Gameplay - 2/5 
Creativity -  2/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
